findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the tests prove `npx @svenroth-ai/shipwright` will run main() on the real published artifact — The mechanism tests use hand-made symlinks to the working-tree bin, not the real npm-pack->install->.bin-symlink path — exactly the class that let this green-but-broken bug ship. RESOLVED: added a hermetic test that `npm pack --ignore-scripts` -> extracts -> invokes the PACKED bin (bin/+lib/ via the files whitelist) through a node_modules/.bin symlink and asserts --version prints; plus the mandated post-publish `npx @next --version` smoke on macOS before announcing.
findings.suggestion: hermetic pack+install+invoke smoke OR documented post-publish npx smoke — both now in place

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the fix covers all package managers a user might launch the bin through — Yarn Berry PnP (`yarn dlx`) has no node_modules symlink; realpathSync on a virtualized PnP path may throw, and the old per-side norm then fell back to path.resolve on ONE side while the other realpath'd — a mixed branch that mismatches and re-introduces the silent no-op. RESOLVED: isMainModule now realpaths BOTH sides in one try and, on ANY throw, falls back to path.resolve on BOTH — no mixed branch. (Advertised surface is npx; PnP is defense-in-depth.)
